caption: The drawing shows a puppet with a rounded head featuring bright red cheeks, a wide red mouth, and pronounced black eyebrows and eyes. The puppet has a single tuft of black hair standing upright on the top of its head. The neck is surrounded by a ruffled yellow collar. The upper body is dressed in a patterned garment with green, gray, and red floral shapes, while the arms are slightly bent with visible brown hands. The puppet’s lower half is clothed in loose-fitting, yellow pants with creases and shading indicating folds. The feet are covered with black shoes. The background is plain and off-white, and the artist’s name, "Florian Rokita," is printed in the bottom right corner.
title: Punch Clown Puppet
